zh: ，在截止之后半分钟（§0§ UTC）才发布，之前谁也算不出来。榜上每个人的规则都在你的浏览器里重跑过，各自单独在一个隔离环境里，互相碰不到；同分的时候先交的排前面。标着"截止后有变动"的，是那条 Issue 在截止之后又动过：可能改了代码，也可能只是有人评论，这里分不出来。规则和裁判在同一个线程里，没法完全隔绝，所以这个榜图个乐。
en: , published half a minute after the deadline (§0§ UTC); nobody could have computed it earlier. Every rule on the board has been re-run in your browser, each in an isolated environment of its own, so they cannot touch one another; when scores are equal, the earlier submission ranks higher. "Changed after the deadline" marks an issue that was touched after the deadline: the code may have been edited, or someone may only have commented, and the page cannot tell which. A rule and the referee share a thread and cannot be completely isolated from each other, so this board is just for fun.
